meta.name: pause-and-resume
meta.description: Cooperatively pause unfinished work in the current session, leave a precise continuation checkpoint, and resume from it when the user later says continue. Use only when the user explicitly requests this pause workflow. Do not use for crashes, app shutdown, new-session handoffs, or ordinary task summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 暂停未完成的工作,留下精确检查点,随时恢复继续
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果工作经常被打断,想暂停后从原位置继续。
copy.tagline_en: Pause work, leave a precise checkpoint, and resume later.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get interrupted and want to pause and resume exactly where you stopped.

howto.what: 用户要求暂停时，Claude 会在当前会话中停止，并给出一个 PAUSE_CHECKPOINT 检查点，记录已完成、剩余工作和恢复步骤；之后说“继续”时，它据此直接恢复，不重复之前已做的事。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确请求暂停工作流时触发；暂停后，用户说“继续”时恢复。

say.text: 先暂停一下，我们待会继续。
say.note: Claude 会暂停并留下检查点。

say.text: 记录一下当前进度，暂停这个任务。
say.note: Claude 会保留进度并停止。
Claude 会从检查点恢复工作。

howto.what_en: When the user explicitly requests a pause, Claude stops and emits a PAUSE_CHECKPOINT with completed and remaining work; on later 'continue', it resumes via that checkpoint without repeating done items.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when the user explicitly requests this pause workflow; resumes when the user later says continue.

say_en.text: Pause for a moment, we'll continue later.
say_en.note: Claude will pause and leave a checkpoint.

say_en.text: Record the progress and pause this task.
say_en.note: Claude will keep progress and stop.
Claude will resume from the checkpoint.
